detail.longDescription: Got # homeassistant , # zwave JS, # esphome , and a few other things up and running on my ancient Odroid U2. The deprecation of # arm v7 (aka the last 32 bit Arm) is annoying for those like me that likes to reuse perfectly functional old hardware. 2GB RAM, 8GB eMMC, and 4 cores at 1.7GHz is plenty for this use case. If anyone needs it, I setup a # github action to keep the v7 esphome container up to date.
